_comment: Sandboxed Lab-revamp bench prototype (systems/bench_prototype.gd, .scratch/lab-revamp/spec.md) -- provisional numbers, not production balance, not cross-referenced by REFERENCE.md. knownAtStart = roster ids listed in the recipe book at start (debug toggles add/remove). rankThresholds[i] is the minimum score for rank i+1. baseCalc is spent per item crafted (a manual run makes one). baseXp is per item, display-only. recipes.*.procedure (Slice A): ideal = the authored perfect procedure (apparatus = data/approaches.json id, ore = the baseCalc ore that must be in the mixture for the step to match, absent for a step that works the existing mixture, target on a 0-100 gauge, weight; weights sum to 100); base = the procedure known at start, its steps' calc summing to baseCalc (one jar tap adds a recipe ore's baseCalc amount); baseTolerance = band half-width before skill widening; hints = the hidden improvements, each naming the ideal step index it reveals (a base step matching that ideal step gets its target corrected, otherwise the ideal step is inserted, no calc). A vague hint shows a region of the band widened by vagueSpread each side and shifted by its offset (|offset| <= vagueSpread, so the band always sits inside); an exact hint shows the true band. PROSE-REVIEW: every hints label/note is new copy. gauges (one per procedure apparatus): heat/compression.risePerSec = needle speed while held; compression.crackAt = the needle value that cracks the vessel and ends the run; grinding.strokes = taps per grind step, swingPeriodSec = one full 0-100-0 pestle swing; directionWords = the notebook's ~ direction for a reading below (higher) or above (lower) the ideal target; distilling.drips = drips per distil step, drip i falls from 0 to 100 over fallMsec starting at i x beatMsec, and a tap reads the falling drip's position against the step target; leadInMsec = screen-only pause before drip 0 (a tap in it is stray). Experimenting: vagueToExactHits = in-band runs on a vague step that upgrade it to exact; clueText = the run result's per-step clue marks (hit/near/none/changed) and learn suffixes (towardExact takes hits so far and vagueToExactHits). ladyScorePerLevel = score points a running Be A Lady (the player's real active effect) adds to a finished run per item level, final score clamped at 100. PROSE-REVIEW: every directionWords, clueText and badRun.lines entry is new copy, drafted against CONTENT-GUIDE.md's tone bible.

vague.note: Finish with a distil. Catch the drips somewhere in the middle.

exact.note: Finish with a distil: four drips, each caught halfway.
Compress to 82. Stop well short of the red line.

vague.note: Grind it once between the press and the heat.

exact.note: Grind between the press and the heat, mid-swing.

vague.note: Distil it between the press and the heat.

exact.note: Distil between the press and the heat, drips caught halfway.

vague.note: Heat it lower than you'd think.

exact.note: Heat to 35. Lower than you'd think.

lines: The mixture sets into something the colour of a bruise. You bin it, and the spoon.
The flask makes a small, polite noise and then a less polite one. The bench will need a new mat.
Whatever this was going to be, it has decided against it.
It smells of burnt hair and Tuesday. You open a window and write nothing down.
The calc goes grey and stays grey. Somewhere, a ledger notes the loss.
